coreMemory.commonError: ❌ write about the paper → ✅ write a paper；❌ write me when you arrive → ✅ write to me when you arrive

commonErrors.note: 表示“写一篇论文”直接用 write a paper；write about 表示“写关于……的内容”

meanings.english: to form letters or words on a surface
meanings.example: Please write your name at the top.
meanings.translation: 请在顶部写下你的姓名。

meanings.english: to produce a text, book, message, or computer code
meanings.example: She writes software for medical devices.
meanings.translation: 她为医疗设备编写软件。

fixedPhrases.example: I wrote a letter to my former teacher.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我给以前的老师写了一封信。

fixedPhrases.example: Write the reference number down before you call.
fixedPhrases.translation: 打电话前把查询号码写下来。

fixedPhrases.example: She writes about science for young readers.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她为年轻读者撰写科学内容。

fixedPhrases.example: He has written for a living since college.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他从大学起就以写作为生。

fixedPhrases.example: Nora wrote back to the editor within two days.
fixedPhrases.translation: 诺拉在两天内给编辑回了信。

fixedPhrases.example: Applicants must write the declaration by hand.
fixedPhrases.translation: 申请人必须手写声明。

fixedPhrases.example: Maya wrote a detailed report on the incident.
fixedPhrases.translation: 玛雅就该事件写了一份详细报告。

fixedPhrases.example: My landlord still lets tenants write a check for the monthly rent.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我的房东仍允许租客用支票支付月租。

fixedPhrases.example: The students wrote code that sorted the records.
fixedPhrases.translation: 学生们写了一段对记录排序的代码。

fixedPhrases.example: We wrote a cancellation clause into the contract.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们在合同里写入了取消条款。

fixedPhrases.example: The bank wrote the unpaid loan off as a loss.
fixedPhrases.translation: 银行把未偿还的贷款作为损失核销了。

fixedPhrases.example: She writes under the name Lena West.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她以莉娜·韦斯特这个名字写作。

口语表达，强调把内容落到纸面；不覆盖 write to、write down 或编写代码等结构

antonyms.usage: 只与写下或记录内容的义项相反；不覆盖 write to、write down 或编写代码等结构

derivatives.note: 表示为了修订内容、结构或风格而重新写一遍

可指写作活动、字迹或文章
技术语境常指文件或存储介质允许写入，日常可指表面适合书写

confusables.difference: 与 write 部分同音，但拼写、词性和含义不同

coreMemory.english: v. to take or carry someone or something to a person or place；v. to cause a situation, result, or feeling
coreMemory.structure: bring something with you /ˈbrɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈwɪð ˈjuː/（随身带某物）；bring someone something /ˈbrɪŋ ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（给某人带来某物）；bring something to someone /ˈbrɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈtuː ˈsʌmˌwʌn/（把某物带给某人）；bring something back /ˈbrɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈbæk/（把某物带回来；使恢复）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ Please bring these boxes away from here. → ✅ Please take these boxes away from here.；❌ She has brought the documents yesterday. → ✅ She brought the documents yesterday.

commonErrors.wrong: Please bring these boxes away from here.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈpliːz ˈbrɪŋ ˈðiːz ˈbɑksəz əˈweɪ ˈfrʌm ˈhiːr/
commonErrors.right: Please take these boxes away from here.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈpliːz ˈteɪk ˈðiːz ˈbɑksəz əˈweɪ ˈfrʌm ˈhiːr/
commonErrors.note: away from here 明确表示离开说话者所在处，因此用 take；bring 表示朝说话者或指定中心带来

commonErrors.wrong: She has brought the documents yesterday.
commonErrors.note: yesterday 是已经结束的过去时间，句子应使用一般过去时 brought，不能使用现在完成时

coreMemory.directSynonym: carry /ˈkæri/（携带）；fetch /ˈfɛtʃ/（去取来）；deliver /dɪˈlɪvɚ/（递送）；take along /ˈteɪk əˈlɔːŋ/（随身带着）；cause /ˈkɑz/（带来；导致）
coreMemory.example: Bring your notes with you to the study session.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 参加学习活动时请带上笔记。

meanings.english: to take or carry someone or something to a person or place
meanings.example: Bring your passport to the appointment.

meanings.english: to cause a situation, result, or feeling
meanings.example: The agreement brought peace to the region.
meanings.translation: 这项协议给该地区带来了和平。

items.phrase: bring the meeting to an end
bring the matter before the board
items.chinese: 将此事提交董事会讨论

items.phrase: bring a topic into the conversation

fixedPhrases.example: Bring your insurance card with you to the appointment.
fixedPhrases.translation: 去就诊时请随身带上保险卡。

fixedPhrases.example: Could you bring me a glass of water?
fixedPhrases.translation: 你能给我带来一杯水吗？

fixedPhrases.example: I brought the signed form to the receptionist.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我把签好字的表格带给了前台。

fixedPhrases.example: This photograph brings back happy memories.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这张照片唤起了快乐的回忆。

fixedPhrases.example: The new law brought about major changes in hiring.
fixedPhrases.translation: 新法律使招聘发生了重大变化。

fixedPhrases.example: You may bring a friend along to the workshop.
fixedPhrases.translation: 你可以带一位朋友一起参加工作坊。

fixedPhrases.example: A final vote brought the debate to an end.
fixedPhrases.translation: 最终投票结束了辩论。

fixedPhrases.example: Investigators promised to bring those responsible to justice.
fixedPhrases.translation: 调查人员承诺将责任人绳之以法。

fixedPhrases.example: Firefighters brought the fire under control by dawn.
fixedPhrases.translation: 消防员在黎明前控制住了火势。

fixedPhrases.example: The survey brings regional differences into focus.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这项调查使地区差异清晰呈现。

fixedPhrases.phrase: bring out the best in someone
fixedPhrases.example: A good coach brings out the best in every player.
fixedPhrases.translation: 好教练能激发每位球员最好的一面。

fixedPhrases.example: She brought the budget issue up at the meeting.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她在会议上提起了预算问题。

coreMemory.english: v. to change position or make something change position；v. to change where one lives or works；v. to affect someone emotionally
coreMemory.structure: move to a new place /ˈmuːv ˈtuː ə ˈnuː ˈpleɪs/（搬到新地方）；move something out of the way /ˈmuːv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈaʊt ˈʌv ðə ˈweɪ/（把某物挪开）；move forward /ˈmuːv ˈfɔːrwɚd/（向前移动；取得进展）；move on /ˈmuːv ˈɑn/（继续前进；转向新话题）

structures.phrase: move something out of the way

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ move to there → ✅ move there；❌ She moved at a new apartment last week. → ✅ She moved to a new apartment last week.

commonErrors.note: there/home/here 是地点副词，前面不加 to

commonErrors.wrong: She moved at a new apartment last week.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈʃiː ˈmuːvd ˈæt ə ˈnuː əˈpɑrtmənt ˈlæst ˈwiːk/
commonErrors.right: She moved to a new apartment last week.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈʃiː ˈmuːvd ˈtuː ə ˈnuː əˈpɑrtmənt ˈlæst ˈwiːk/
commonErrors.note: move 表示搬到新住址时用 move to + 地点；at 只说明静态位置

coreMemory.directSynonym: shift /ˈʃɪft/（挪动；转变）；relocate /ˌriːˈloʊkeɪt/（搬迁）；transfer /trænsˈfɝː/（转移；调动）；advance /ədˈvæns/（推进）；stir /ˈstɝː/（打动；使活动）
coreMemory.example: We plan to move to a quieter neighborhood.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 我们打算搬到一个更安静的社区。

meanings.example: Move the chair closer to the table.

meanings.english: to change where one lives or works

items.chinese: 移到离窗户更近的地方

fixedPhrases.translation: 他们去年搬到了一个更安静的社区。

fixedPhrases.phrase: move something out of the way

fixedPhrases.translation: 客人到来前，一名搬运工把箱子挪开了。

fixedPhrases.example: We cannot move forward without reliable data.
fixedPhrases.translation: 没有可靠数据，我们无法推进。

fixedPhrases.example: Let's move on to the next item.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们进入下一项吧。

fixedPhrases.translation: 队伍以稳定的速度向前移动。

fixedPhrases.translation: 日出前，救援队已进入指定位置。
